meta_description:
11K likes, 297 comments - loganpaul on October 12, 2026: "$400,000 in Pokémon boxes. $800,000 in Unpeeled sheets… and one glorious Shiny evolution ✨ ALL IN ONE NIGHT

Legendary Collection is the hottest set in Pokémon right now with the chase cards achieving record prices of $400,000+ in PSA 10s (reverse holo Pikachu, Gengar, Snorlax, Charizard & many more). And… there’s a reverse holo in EVERY PACK 🤯 

I also have two Unpeeled Corocoro sheets from 1996 containing the first two Pokémon Trading Cards EVER (Pikachu & Jigglypuff) that are ready to be peeled… and this time I will peel the ONE and ONLY PSA 10 Pikachu #1 😏

& lastly, I will be evolving my Shiny Onix that I took 63 HOURS HUNTING into the most epic Shiny Pokemon of them all, Shiny Steelix 

Tune in October 29, 6p EST LIVE on my YouTube channel for another epic night in Pokémon history

Bid for the 72 Legendary Collection Packs that include a shoutout for you/your brand right now on Goldin.com".
